Package aor.proj3t.daos.interfaces

Interface MessageDAO

All Superinterfaces:
BasicDAO<Message,Long>
All Known Implementing Classes:
MessageDAOimpl
public interface MessageDAO extends BasicDAO<Message,Long>
Data Access Object interface for Message entity operations.

This interface extends BasicDAO to provide comprehensive operations for managing internal messaging system within the application. Messages facilitate communication between users in the system.

Key features include:

  • Querying messages by sender and recipient
  • Finding conversation participants
  • Counting unread messages for notifications
  • Message status management (read/unread)
  • Conversation history tracking

  • Method Details

    • findBySenderId

      List<Message> findBySenderId(Long senderId)
      Retrieves all messages sent by a specific user.

      This method finds all messages where the specified user is the sender. Useful for displaying user's sent message history and outbox functionality.

      Parameters:
      senderId - The unique identifier of the sender. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      A List of messages sent by the specified user, or an empty list if no messages are found

    • findByRecipientId

      List<Message> findByRecipientId(Long recipientId)
      Retrieves all messages received by a specific user.

      This method finds all messages where the specified user is the recipient. Essential for displaying user's inbox and message history.

      Parameters:
      recipientId - The unique identifier of the recipient. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      A List of messages received by the specified user, or an empty list if no messages are found

    • findBySenderIdAndRecipientId

      List<Message> findBySenderIdAndRecipientId(Long senderId, Long recipientId)
      Retrieves all messages exchanged between two specific users.

      This method finds all messages where one user is the sender and the other is the recipient, regardless of direction. Useful for displaying complete conversation history between two users.

      Parameters:
      senderId - The unique identifier of the sender. Must not be null.
      recipientId - The unique identifier of the recipient. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      A List of messages exchanged between the sender and recipient, or an empty list if no messages are found

    • findMessagedUsers

      List<User> findMessagedUsers(Long userId)
      Retrieves all unique users that have exchanged messages with a given user.

      This method finds all users who have either sent messages to or received messages from the specified user. Essential for displaying conversation participants and contact lists.

      Parameters:
      userId - The unique identifier of the user. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      A List of unique users who have interacted with the specified user, or an empty list if no interactions are found

    • findCountUnreadMessagesByRecipientId

      Integer findCountUnreadMessagesByRecipientId(Long recipientId)
      Counts the total number of unread messages for a specific user.

      This method provides a count of all messages received by the user that have not been marked as read. Essential for notification badges and message alerts in the user interface.

      Parameters:
      recipientId - The unique identifier of the recipient. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      The count of unread messages, or 0 if no unread messages exist

    • findCountUnreadMessagesBetweenUsers

      Integer findCountUnreadMessagesBetweenUsers(Long recipientId, Long senderId)
      Counts unread messages between two specific users.

      This method provides a count of unread messages from a specific sender to a specific recipient. Useful for displaying conversation-specific unread message counts.

      Parameters:
      recipientId - The unique identifier of the recipient. Must not be null.
      senderId - The unique identifier of the sender. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      The count of unread messages from sender to recipient, or 0 if none exist

    • markMessageAsRead

      Boolean markMessageAsRead(Long messageId)
      Marks a specific message as read.

      This method updates the read status of a message to indicate that it has been viewed by the recipient. This affects unread message counts and notification states.

      Parameters:
      messageId - The unique identifier of the message to mark as read. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      true if the message was successfully marked as read, false if the operation failed or the message was not found
